title: static members
author: JG
description: LinearSolver GeneralMatrixEXUdense::FactorizeNew has static ResizableMatrix m, which should be turned into class members; add reset method to free memory at solver finalization
releaseNotes: The dense solver keeps the temporaries of its factorization with the matrix instead of in static variables: no allocation at a repeated factorization, freed with the matrix (cleanUpMemory), not shared between solvers (revision2026c step RG11.8.6)
